scope: separate exposed development funnel; core v6 unchanged; no scientific execution in design session

trainables.implementation: torch.func.functional_call(model,{name:master.to(bfloat16)},strict=False,tie_weights=True); all actual model parameters requires_grad False; only enumerated fp32 masters require grad
trainables.final_decode: copy masters rounded bf16 into exact LN names only; decode ordinary frozen-model path; restore original bf16 bytes in finally

optimization.reset: new masters and optimizer from exact theta0 each objective/utterance; no optimizer/cache/gradient state transfer; reset actual bf16 LN, verify exact hash and flags; all other parameters immutable

teacher_forcing.input: cB+y; no appended EOS; explicit IDs (no labels auto-shift), use_cache=False, no past KV; ordinary detached non-inference encoder outputs reused
teacher_forcing.target_query: content token t predicted by raw logits at absolute decoder index3+t for t=0..T-1; final query3+T reports EOS probability only
teacher_forcing.suppression: generation_config.suppress_tokens all content positions, begin_suppress_tokens at t0 only; float32 log_softmax on finite allowed vocabulary, no 0*(-inf)
teacher_forcing.teacher_special_handling: preserve generated content IDs including UTF8 fragments; strip only verified initial AUTO prompt/terminal EOS if present; unexpected interior control IDs INVALID; no text retokenization
teacher_forcing.valid_positions: fixed from theta0 teacher: non-special content ID AND target not suppressed at t; log exclusions/counts; same loss mask for both steps
teacher_forcing.cap: use complete frozen prefix up to200 generated content IDs even if capped; do not invent EOS target
teacher_forcing.empty: exactly2 no-op AdamW steps with scalar zero connected to masters and zero gradients; log no_valid_content, loss0; final baseline identity; no drop/refill
teacher_forcing.encoder: one original frozen encoder per utterance, detached clone outside inference_mode; no encoder recomputation during objectives; no encoder grads/cache carry

decode.forced_path: existing cached.Branch.step(cB then one token), capture_layer=16 PASSIVE recorder, attention=True, processed_argmax, no action hook; audit theta0 token equality vs P2SEQ S0
decode.runtime_failure: nonfinite loss/grad/master/effective params/logits or reset/provider/path mismatch =>INVALID and STOP; do not change clipping/LR/precision

metrics: P2SEQ lexical outside-POI edits/harm with counts

uncertainty.unit: 20 sorted dialogues one utterance each, paired draws
uncertainty.CI: 95% pointwise percentile of corpus count-sum ratios; descriptive only, no significance gate; omit empty denominator draws, disclose counts

original_tta0_decision.useful: net POI reduction>=2 OR >=3 utterances have fewer mixed errors than forced AND improved count>degraded count; ties not improvements
original_tta0_decision.safety: all point safety bounds, no new severe truncation; empty baseline-correct rate denominator=>None and explicitly not assessable/vacuous bound; nonempty primary reference language populations required
original_tta0_decision.EM_confirmation_bias: A1 token-weighted corpus mean entropy on fixed y_B valid positions decreases>=1% from initial AND any MER/ZH/retention/outside/corruption/truncation/cap safety bound fails; distinct from no-gain; not automatic for entropy-only shrinkage
original_tta0_decision.selection: only viable =>select; neither =>NO_VIABLE; both lexicographically lower corpus MER, PIER, ZH-CER, mean per-utterance fp32-master update L2; tolerance1e-12 per float tie, then fixed A2 (problem-specific) exact tie

TTA0_R.diagnostic_only_basis: recorded CPU fp32/bf16 discrepancies 0.00749-0.01044; recorded live A1 0.01025; no reference outcomes
TTA0_R.rules: original_tta0_decision exact copy; original TTA0 losses/masks/decode/viability/confirmation bias/tie break unchanged

A1.name: GREEDY_EM
A1.teacher: theta0 B0_FORCED generated content IDs only, sealed before updates
A1.loss: mean over fixed valid content t of -sum over allowed v p_t(v)*log p_t(v); all predictive allowed tokens including EOS; no CE/pseudo-label term

A3.loss: mean valid t sum allowed v q_t(v)*(log q_t(v)-log p_t(v)); full vocabulary, stop-gradient theta0 AUTO teacher; forced-ZH student; identical y_A content prefixes
A3.AUTO_condition: theta0 HF Whisper detect_language on detached encoder, then SOT/native-language/transcribe/no-timestamps; never substitute EN
A3.teacher: existing theta0 AUTO greedy content IDs; q/logq computed once before updates, detached float32; no top-k
A3.mask: same original content target validity and generation suppression for teacher and student; EOS excluded target but included predictive class

MAP.selection: only OBJECTIVE_PROMISING; lower MER, PIER, ZH-CER, outside harm, mean fp32 update L2; per-component float tie 1e-12; exact tie A3

diagnosis_predicates.optimized: at least6 L0>=1e-4 rows; token-weighted relative objective decrease>=0.10; ceil(0.60*n_informative) rows individually decrease>=0.10
diagnosis_predicates.gap_closed: D token-weighted D_cond0>=0.01 AND relative D_cond decrease>=0.10
diagnosis_predicates.sequence_movement: ceil(0.25*n_D) D content token sequences change from FORCED
diagnosis_predicates.toward_AUTO: ceil(0.25*n_D) D token Levenshtein distances strictly decrease AND summed D distance decreases>=0.10
diagnosis_predicates.teacher_attribution: candidate unsafe AND toward_AUTO AND AUTO unsafe by same frozen point bounds
diagnosis_predicates.strong_instability: new severe truncation OR extra caps>1 OR deletion errors/reference mixed units increase>0.01 AND total content-length ratio<0.90
diagnosis_predicates.sequence_instability: candidate unsafe AND (strong_instability OR NOT teacher_attribution)
diagnosis_predicates.promising_A1: optimized AND original TTA0 safe AND original TTA0 useful
diagnosis_predicates.promising_A3: promising_A1 AND gap_closed AND sequence_movement AND toward_AUTO AND n_D>=6
diagnosis_predicates.condition_gap_not_closed: not promising and not gap_closed, after higher-precedence labels
diagnosis_predicates.sequence_leverage_limit: remaining non-promising cases after higher-precedence labels; record absent/away/unhelpful output movement

TTA1.run_only_if: exactly one objective in audited immutable R or MAP selection artifact
TTA1.benefit: both net POI reduction>=5 AND PIER decrease>=0.005; no utterance-count alternative; descriptive CI, no significance gate
TTA1.adapted_reuse: reuse only independently audited exact same objective/settings/theta0 episodes; all compatible rows, no outcome filtering; MAP first then R; otherwise new episodes in single job

audit.independent: no import primary analysis/decision; own formula, counts, bootstrap, labels and selection; canonical evaluator primitives allowed
audit.float64: existing numerical artifact exact primary/auditor gradient equivalence and repeated fp32 equivalence retained; new A3 formula tested float64 independently before run
audit.github_gate: resolved manifest/preaudit/teacher seals/selection artifact pushed before dependent outcome
audit.partial: missing outputs, nonfinite, wall-clock budget overrun or sealed-input hash mismatch => invalid STOP; token-cap safety handled by outcome rules

compute.budget_failure: seal partial INVALID, stop; no extra job or expanded budget

github: checks -> inspect diff -> commit -> push origin HEAD:cs-asr-steer-inf; no force, main merge, PR
source_anchor_policy: Original source hashes are historical provenance at starting_commit; verify historical bytes through git if extended during implementation. New implementation code hashes must be frozen in resolved pre-run manifest. Immutable scientific configs/results/panels remain byte-identical.
